report_name: ASOS Customers Receive 'Hacked' Messages After Partner Breach

threat_actors.name: Opportunistic Actor (ASOS Breach)
threat_actors.description: An opportunistic and likely unsophisticated actor responsible for the ASOS communications breach. The actor's associated Telegram account was also involved in trading accounts for online games, suggesting a lower level of sophistication.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The attacker compromised a third-party customer communications platform used by ASOS to gain access and send unauthorized push notifications to customers.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker abused the compromised account or access of the third-party communications vendor to use its legitimate functionality to send malicious and disruptive push notifications to ASOS app users.

identities.name: ASOS
identities.description: Global online fashion retailer whose customers received unauthorized push notifications due to a security breach at a third-party communications partner.

infrastructure.name: Compromised Third-Party Communications Platform
infrastructure.description: A third-party service provider responsible for ASOS's customer push notifications was compromised by an attacker, who then used its capabilities to send rogue messages.

indicators.name: Access to Push Notification API Endpoint
indicators.pattern:
title: Access to Push Notification API Endpoint
id: 2b8a1c3d-f4e5-4b6a-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects access to a push notification sending API endpoint. While this can be legitimate, a high volume of requests or requests from unexpected sources should be investigated as potential abuse of a compromised communications platform.
references:
  - https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/fbi-secret-service-fortibleed/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-07
tags:
  - attack.t1078
level: informational
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri-stem|contains: '/send-push-notification'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects access to a push notification sending API endpoint, which could indicate abuse of a compromised communications platform as seen in the ASOS breach.

relationships.source_name: Access to Push Notification API Endpoint
